breakdown.description: Inviscid simulation requested but top wall uses noSlip; inviscid wall should not impose no-slip viscous condition
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification correctly states it is an "inviscid" simulation and sets viscosity to zero, but it then incorrectly repeats the user's contradictory instruction to "Apply noSlip velocity boundary condition at the top wall." A no-slip condition is for viscous flows; an inviscid simulation should use a slip or symmetry boundary condition on a solid wall.
